name: Hunger
description: How fed you are, by your own reckoning — Full down to Starving. Eat to restore it.

name: Thirst
description: How hydrated you feel — Slaked down to Dry as dust. Drink to restore it.

name: Bladder
description: How badly you need to relieve yourself — Empty down to Desperate.

name: Hygiene
description: How clean you feel — Fresh down to Reeking. Wash up to restore it.

name: Calm
description: Composure under stress and fear — Serene down to Panicked. Always eases back toward a baseline over time.
